chapterInfo.content:
12
Efraim di nkoguo
1 # Ate 8.1 Na Efraim mmarima hyiae, na wɔtwa kɔɔ Safon, na wɔka kyerɛɛ Yefta sɛ: Adɛn nti na wotwaa mu kɔeɛ ne Amonfoɔ kɔkoeɛ, na yɛn deɛ, woamfrɛ yɛn na yɛne wo ankorɔ? Yɛde gya bɛhye wo fie agu wo so. 2Na Yefta ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Me ne me nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa ne Amonfoɔ nyaa manso kɛseɛ; na meteaa mu mefrɛɛ mo no, moannye me amfiri wɔn nsam; 3#Ate 5.18; 9.17 na mehunuu sɛ moremma mmɛgye me no, mede me nkwa metoo me nsam, na mesene mekɔɔ Amonfoɔ no so, na AWURADE de wɔn hyɛɛ me nsa, na adɛn na moaforo aba me soɔ ne me rebɛko nnɛ yi? 4Na Yefta boaa Gilead mmarima nyinaa ano na ɔne Efraim koe; na Gilead mmarima no kunkumm Efraimfoɔ no, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔse: Moyɛ Efraim adwanefoɔ, mo Gileadfoɔ, mowɔ Efraim mu, na mowɔ Manase mu. 5Na Gilead faa Yordan atwaeɛ twaree Efraim; na sɛ Efraim adwanefoɔ no mu bi ka sɛ: Ma mentwa a, ɛnneɛ Gilead mmarima no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Woyɛ Efraimni anaa? Na ɔse: Dabi a, 6wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛnneɛ ka sɛ Shibolet, na ɔka sɛ: Sibolet, ɛfiri sɛ ɔntumi nka no yie a, na wɔakye no aku no Yordan atwaeɛ hɔ. Na saa berɛ no Efraimfoɔ mpemaduanan mmienu na ɛtotɔeɛ.
7Na Yefta buu Israel atɛn mfeɛ nsia. Na Gileadni Yefta wui, na wɔsiee no Gilead nkuro no bi mu.
Ibsan, Elon ne Abdon ho asɛm
8Na n’akyiri no, Ibsan a ɔfiri Betlehem buu Israel atɛn. 9Na ɔwɔ mmammarima aduasa, na ɔde mmammaa aduasa memaa awareɛ mmeammea, na ɔkɔgyegyee mmabaa aduasa nso firi mmeammea brɛɛ ne mmammarima awareɛ. Na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ nson. 10Na Ibsan wui, na wɔsiee no Betlehem.
11Na n’akyiri no, Sebulonni Elon buu Israel atɛn. Na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ du. 12Na Sebulonni Elon wui, na wɔsiee no Ayalon, Sebulon asase so.
13Na n’akyiri no, Hilel ba Abdon a ɔyɛ Piratonni buu Israel atɛn. 14Na ɔwɔ mmammarima aduanan ne mmanana aduasa a wɔtenaa mfunumu aduɔson soɔ. Na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ nwɔtwe. 15Na Hilel ba Abdon a ɔyɛ Piratonni no wui, na wɔsiee no Piraton wɔ Efraim asase a ɛwɔ Amalekfoɔ bepɔ soɔ no so.

Na Efraim mmarima hyiae, na wɔtwa kɔɔ Safon, na wɔka kyerɛɛ Yefta sɛ: Adɛn nti na wotwaa mu kɔeɛ ne Amonfoɔ kɔkoeɛ, na yɛn deɛ, woamfrɛ yɛn na yɛne wo ankorɔ? Yɛde gya bɛhye wo fie agu wo so. Na Yefta ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Me ne me nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa ne Amonfoɔ nyaa manso kɛseɛ; na meteaa mu mefrɛɛ mo no, moannye me amfiri wɔn nsam; na mehunuu sɛ moremma mmɛgye me no, mede me nkwa metoo me nsam, na mesene mekɔɔ Amonfoɔ no so, na AWURADE de wɔn hyɛɛ me nsa, na adɛn na moaforo aba me soɔ ne me rebɛko nnɛ yi? Na Yefta boaa Gilead mmarima nyinaa ano na ɔne Efraim koe; na Gilead mmarima no kunkumm Efraimfoɔ no, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔse: Moyɛ Efraim adwanefoɔ, mo Gileadfoɔ, mowɔ Efraim mu, na mowɔ Manase mu. Na Gilead faa Yordan atwaeɛ twaree Efraim; na sɛ Efraim adwanefoɔ no mu bi ka sɛ: Ma mentwa a, ɛnneɛ Gilead mmarima no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Woyɛ Efraimni anaa? Na ɔse: Dabi a, wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛnneɛ ka sɛ Shibolet, na ɔka sɛ: Sibolet, ɛfiri sɛ ɔntumi nka no yie a, na wɔakye no aku no Yordan atwaeɛ hɔ. Na saa berɛ no Efraimfoɔ mpemaduanan mmienu na ɛtotɔeɛ.
Na Yefta buu Israel atɛn mfeɛ nsia. Na Gileadni Yefta wui, na wɔsiee no Gilead nkuro no bi mu.

Na n’akyiri no, Ibsan a ɔfiri Betlehem buu Israel atɛn. Na ɔwɔ mmammarima aduasa, na ɔde mmammaa aduasa memaa awareɛ mmeammea, na ɔkɔgyegyee mmabaa aduasa nso firi mmeammea brɛɛ ne mmammarima awareɛ. Na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ nson. Na Ibsan wui, na wɔsiee no Betlehem.
Na n’akyiri no, Sebulonni Elon buu Israel atɛn. Na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ du. Na Sebulonni Elon wui, na wɔsiee no Ayalon, Sebulon asase so.
Na n’akyiri no, Hilel ba Abdon a ɔyɛ Piratonni buu Israel atɛn. Na ɔwɔ mmammarima aduanan ne mmanana aduasa a wɔtenaa mfunumu aduɔson soɔ. Na ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfeɛ nwɔtwe. Na Hilel ba Abdon a ɔyɛ Piratonni no wui, na wɔsiee no Piraton wɔ Efraim asase a ɛwɔ Amalekfoɔ bepɔ soɔ no so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
